checks.assessment: Room-macro results and all seven paired room results shown; overall improvement is not assumed to hold in each room.
No claim of per-hour tolerance or coverage for all 476 rooms from room averages.
Seven representative development rooms are a selected sample; external population generalization remains unproven.
No causal effect estimation; added features are input-derived, no target-derived covariates.
Regression task; no classification accuracy claim. Dark-room scales shown beside absolute error.
No before/after field intervention claim; paired frozen-baseline comparisons use identical held-room rows.
All seven rooms and every predeclared profile/family/target are reported, including worse results.
All candidates reported; best-room and best-method summaries labeled post-hoc development descriptions. No p-values/significance claims.
Config frozen before training; two candidates per family; previous development history disclosed; TEST sealed.
Ablation evaluates predictive changes, not a proven physical cause of room illumination or a guaranteed feature benefit.
Inference uses X only; target transforms and ratio labels are fitting-stage outputs, not true targets supplied at prediction.

scientific_inference_scope: Descriptive development comparison, not independent confirmatory evidence or a calibrated uncertainty estimate.
